signature.instructions:
text
TASK: Strict change detection for technical-document images (tables/diagrams/pages) with discard/keep rules and exact JSON output

INPUTS
- You may receive up to 2 images:
  - image_original = Image 1 (old)
  - image_reimage  = Image 2 (new)
- Either image may be None.

OUTPUT (absolute requirement)
- Output EXACTLY one JSON object on a single line, with EXACTLY these two keys:
  {"discard_image": true/false, "changes": "..."}
- No other keys, no markdown, no extra text.

PRIMARY GOALS
1) Decide whether to discard the pair (discard_image=true) or keep it (discard_image=false).
2) If kept, report ONLY meaningful, clearly visible informational content changes (no speculation).

ANTI-HALLUCINATION / READABILITY RULES (highest priority)
- Compare ONLY what is literally visible in the pixels.
- Treat text as identical unless you can unambiguously read BOTH the old and new strings and confirm they differ EXACTLY as written.
  - Do NOT normalize: case, spacing, line breaks, font, alignment, kerning, hyphenation.
- You may report a change ONLY if:
  (a) you can match the same element/location in both images, AND
  (b) both sides are clearly readable, AND
  (c) the difference changes meaning (see “Meaningful changes”).
- If any required part is too blurry/tiny/occluded to compare reliably:
  - discard_image=false
  - changes="Could not infer"
  (Do not guess. Do not “best effort” read.)

TRIVIAL DIFFERENCES TO IGNORE (do NOT count as changes)
- Cropping/margins, layout shifts, resizing, resolution/compression artifacts
- Minor color shade changes
- Punctuation-only differences
- Watermark added/removed if it does not change the informational content
- Purely stylistic branding/typography/logo variations (including different GM logos, wordmark style, capitalization, font)

IMPORTANT DOMAIN-SPECIFIC NOTES
- Do NOT discard as “identical” if an informational header/title INSIDE the content area is added/removed/changed and is readable (titles are content).
- For diagrams (block/sequence/flow):
  - Do NOT claim a connection/arrow was added/removed/changed unless you can clearly verify both endpoints in both images.
  - If endpoints are unclear or the difference could be due to crop/scale/rendering → do NOT report; if this prevents comparison → "Could not infer".
- Branding/logo-only pages (e.g., just a GM logo/wordmark) are NON-INFORMATIONAL even if styling differs; treat as discardable when both are such pages.

INFORMATIONAL vs NON-INFORMATIONAL (for single-image or mismatch cases)
NON-INFORMATIONAL examples:
- Blank page or blank block
- Divider line only
- Standalone logo/brand mark/wordmark only (e.g., GM logo only)
- Watermark-only page (e.g., only diagonal “GM Confidential” text)
- Standalone section number only (e.g., “5.2.1”) with no other content
INFORMATIONAL examples:
- Readable paragraphs, headings WITH body text
- Tables with readable cells
- Charts with readable labels/values
- Diagrams with readable labels/connectors

DECISION LOGIC (follow exactly; default is discard)
Default output (use when applicable):
{"discard_image": true, "changes": "Images are identical - no changes"}

A) If only ONE image is provided (the other is None):
   1) If the single image is NON-INFORMATIONAL:
      - discard_image=true
      - changes must be EXACTLY:
        "Only one image which is non-informational and it contains logo (or watermark / blank block / single line / standalone section number / etc.)"
   2) If the single image is INFORMATIONAL:
      - discard_image=false
      - changes="NoMatchFound"

B) If either image is corrupted / too tiny / unreadable AND this prevents reliable comparison:
   - discard_image=false
   - changes="Could not infer"

C) If an image is crossed out with a full-page X/strikethrough indicating deletion:
   - discard_image=false
   - changes must be EXACTLY one of:
     "Image 1 has been crossed out"
     "Image 2 has been crossed out"

D) If BOTH images are NON-INFORMATIONAL:
   - discard_image=true
   - changes must be EXACTLY:
     "Both images are non informational and contain only logos / etc.."
   (Use this especially for watermark-only pages like “GM Confidential” and for logo-only pages.)

E) If one image is NON-INFORMATIONAL and the other is INFORMATIONAL:
   - discard_image=false
   - changes must:
     (i) state that only one image is informational, AND
     (ii) briefly describe what the informational image contains (e.g., “a table of electrical requirements”, “a block diagram with labeled components”).

F) If BOTH images are INFORMATIONAL:
   1) If identical OR differ only by TRIVIAL differences (including watermark/branding/typography-only):
      - discard_image=true
      - changes="Images are identical - no changes"
      (Example: same diagram but one image has extra surrounding page text or watermark only → still identical.)
   2) If there are clear MEANINGFUL informational differences:
      - discard_image=false
      - changes must follow the template below.

WHAT COUNTS AS MEANINGFUL INFORMATIONAL CHANGE (report only these)
- Words/sentences/labels/titles added/removed/replaced with clear meaning impact (including diagram titles when readable)
- Numbers/dates/units/values changed (must quote exact old/new)
- Table row/column/cell content changed (quote exact old/new)
- Diagram elements added/removed; arrow directions changed; clearly different label text (not styling)
- Entire informational blocks/sections added/removed

CHANGES FIELD TEMPLATE (ONLY when meaningful differences exist)
"OVERVIEW: <brief summary> | DETAILS (Each Change): 1) <Location/region>: '<Old text/element (Image 1)>' → '<New text/element (Image 2)>'; 2) ..."

LOCATION/REGION GUIDANCE
Use simple, precise references such as:
- “Top title area”
- “Table row ‘Maximum Leakage Current…’”
- “Middle block labeled ‘CSM SW (Android)’”
- “Right-side connector labels”
- “Alt block header”

FINAL REMINDERS
- If you cannot read both sides clearly, do NOT claim a change; use "Could not infer" if that blocks comparison.
- If the only differences are watermark/branding/typography and there is no informational content change, discard with:
  {"discard_image": true, "changes": "Images are identical - no changes"}
